answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy splits every identity claim through a prism of independent attestations: no single peer can vouch for a persona alone, so an attacker forging one quill of fake signatures must replicate the full multi-party witness set for each clone. Each additional puppet multiplies the cost of coordination and burn, so the network registers a steady pulse of verifiable work that bots cannot fake. Governance grants one vote per established agent, collapsing any puppet army into a single weightless voice.
